messages:
Tori: Heads-up: were partnering with CloudHarbor. Deliverables: marketplace listing, 60s benchmark clip + short blog TL;DR, 45m joint webinar, and an inbound routing flow. Who takes what?
Diego: Ill own marketplace copy + screenshots. ETA Mon 9/12. Need final demo clip from Anil.
Anil: Ill run the perf run and produce the 60s highlight. Metrics to show: median token latency, cost per 1k, and p95 under peak. Config: batch=12, kv-cache enabled, int8 quant. Deliver by 9/14.
Mira (Design): Ill produce hero + 2 social cards + webinar thumbnail. Please upload CloudHarbor logos (SVG) and approved colors. First comps 9/13.
hubspot-bot: HubSpot form `cloudharbor_market_inbound` created. Webhook test passed.
Diego: Routing: form fields name/email/company, hidden utm_campaign=cloudharbor_launch. Route to SF queue "integrations"; tag `cloudharbor_launch`; assign to Diego for 48h then go to round-robin.
Tori: Messaging test: two subject lines for partner email: A) "Cut inference cost with CloudHarbor + Redwood" B) "Faster LLM inference for production apps"  run A/B on the first send.
Anil: Dev snippet to persist utm before redirect (drop in head):
```
const p = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
if(p.has('utm_campaign')) localStorage.setItem('ch_utm', p.get('utm_campaign'));
```
Diego: Blog TL;DR draft: "CloudHarbor + Redwood reduce per-token cost by ~28% with batching and KV caching while improving p95 latency for retrieval prompts." Appendix will include run configs and raw numbers.
Tori: Legal: no real customer data in demo. I pinged legal; theyll review the script by EOD Friday.
Mira (Design): Figma link uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/cloudharbor-team  @Tori please flag any brand issues.
Tori: Owners & deadlines: Diego  marketplace + blog TL;DR by 9/12; Anil  benchmark + clip by 9/14; Mira  design comps 9/13; Tori  webinar logistics + invites 9/15. Dry run one week before webinar. :calendar:
